tk_source: M=accFactorialRec;F=factorialRec(n:i64):i64{if(n<1){<1;}el{if(n=1){<1;}el{<n*factorialRec(n-1);}}};F=digitSum(n:i64):i64{let num=n;let isNeg=num<0;let absNum=num;if(isNeg){absNum=0-absNum};let sum=mut.0;let current=absNum;lp(let i=0;!(current=0);i=i+1){let digit=current-current/10*10;sum=sum+digit;current=current/10};<sum};F=digitSumFactorialrec(n:i64):i64{<digitSum(factorialRec(n))};F=accumulate(arr:[i64]):i64{let r=mut.0;lp(let i=0;i<arr.len as i64;i=i+1){r=r+factorialRec(arr[i as u64]);};<r};
